_comment: Calendars aggregated into #schedule. Copy to schedule_calendars.json and fill in your own. Order = display/legend order. 'id' is a public Google Calendar id (works with GOOGLE_API_KEY, no OAuth); 'ics' is an optional fallback feed tried when the API fails. 'color' is a hex string, or a list of hexes for a gradient (used on month-grid bars and the legend). 'badge' names an icon from the top-level 'badges' map: either a url to a square image (fetched once, cached in badge_cache/) or 'discord-avatar:<user_id>' for a user's live Discord avatar (circle-cropped, tracks avatar changes). Badges are drawn in the month grid/legend and uploaded as app emojis for the week view — colored dots are the fallback. 'rules' override color/badge per event by case-insensitive title substring; first match wins.
